name: Bilgeri Camping
beschreibung:
The Bilgeri campsite is located on Krähenberg above Sibratsgfäll in the Bregenzerwald in Vorarlberg, at around 925 meters altitude. The site is operated by Edelbert Bilgeri, the address is Krähenberg 122, 6952 Sibratsgfäll. It is designed as a permanent campsite, no daily pitches are available. A snack bar on site is open Thursday through Sunday, dogs are allowed.

The surroundings are characterized by hiking trails and cross-country ski tracks: A winter hike by the tourism association leads along the cross-country ski trail directly past the campsite, nearby are the Vorsäß Schönenbach (mountain pasture) and the Krähenberg lift. Sibratsgfäll lies at about 930 meters in the Nagelfluhkette Nature Park, surrounded by the Gottesackerwände, Hoher Ifen, Diedamskopf, and Winterstaude peaks.
